metadata.title: Sara Kitchen
metadata.description: Persian homemade food in Porto, Portugal.

about.title: Our Story
about.summary: Sara Kitchen brings Persian homemade food to Porto, prepared with care and fresh ingredients.
about.storyFallback: Discover Persian home cooking, made with care in Porto. Our menu brings traditional flavours and fresh ingredients together at your table.

contact.title: Get in touch
contact.intro: Questions about our Persian food or an order? Send us a message and we will get back to you.
contact.detailsUnavailable: Our contact details are being updated. You can still send us a message below.
contact.formIntro: We would love to hear from you.
contact.name: Full name
contact.contactMethodHint: Provide a phone number or an email address so we can reply.
contact.consent: I agree to Sara Kitchen using my contact details to reply to this message.
contact.privacyNotice: We use these details only to handle your enquiry. This is not marketing consent.

home.title: The warmth of Persian home cooking

forgotPassword.title: Forgot your password?
forgotPassword.description: Enter your mobile number or email. If an eligible account exists, we'll text a reset link to its mobile number.

resetPassword.description: Choose a new passphrase. Your reset link expires after 15 minutes and can be used once.

resetPassword.invalid: This reset link is invalid, expired, or already used.
resetPassword.error: We couldn't reset your password. Please try again.
